title: SimpleGrid
oneLiner: 균등 칼럼 반응형 그리드 — min-child-width로 repeat(auto-fill, minmax(N, 1fr)). GridLayout 별칭 파생.

web.code:
<jd-simple-grid min-child-width="{minChildWidth}" gap="{gap}">
  <jd-box p="3" bg="card" radius="md" border>카드</jd-box>
  <jd-box p="3" bg="card" radius="md" border>카드</jd-box>
  <jd-box p="3" bg="card" radius="md" border>카드</jd-box>
</jd-simple-grid>
